descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在景德镇吃过冷粉后画的菜单。粗圆的米粉旁边，一小片橘子皮被我画得太大，只好补个小碗作比较。
descriptions.en: My menu after trying lengfen in Jingdezhen. The thick noodles share the page with an oversized tangerine-peel sketch and a little bowl added for scale.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在景德镇吃过韭菜豆干馅饺子粑后凭记忆画的菜单。多画出来的那一个戴着邮差帽，是我临时安排的菜单看守员。
descriptions.en: Drawn from memory after chive-and-tofu jiaoziba in Jingdezhen. The extra dumpling in a postal cap is my newly appointed menu guard.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 看过景德镇御窑博物馆后，我自己折的弧形纸样。它的折痕有点歪，站起来的每一小会儿都值得记一笔。
descriptions.en: A little curved paper model I folded after seeing Jingdezhen’s Imperial Kiln Museum. Its uneven creases make every brief standing performance worth recording.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在景德镇吃完饺子粑，我给自己的菜单草稿点了一遍数。多出来的那一个有了邮差帽，这张便签记录了它的上岗。
descriptions.en: After jiaoziba in Jingdezhen, I counted the outlines on my menu draft. The extra one received a postal cap; this homemade slip records its appointment.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 参观景德镇中国陶瓷博物馆后，我凭记忆画下几道器物轮廓。没有给它们编名字或年代，纸角只写着“今天记住的样子”。
descriptions.en: After Jingdezhen China Ceramics Museum, I drew a few remembered outlines. No invented names or dates, just “Shapes I remembered today” in the corner.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在景德镇御窑博物馆外，我和两位旅人各折一段纸样，拼出自己的歪隧道。入口的小邮包和出口的灯，是他们随手添给我的路标。
descriptions.en: Outside Jingdezhen’s Imperial Kiln Museum, two travelers and I each folded a section of our own crooked tunnel. They drew a mailbag and a light at opposite ends to show the way.
